correctness.rationale: Twelve independent binary comparisons realize every directed cube; exact reachability definitions apply. A geometric proof treats one, two, and at least three sinks and shows that any cyclic orientation with a sink is connected. A source/sink parity argument proves that no acyclic cube orientation is super-connected. Exact exhaustive 4096-orientation code gives all five class counts and independently cross-checks reverse reachability, DFS versus Kahn cycle tests, Burnside orbit totals, and sink factorial moments; all assertions executed successfully. Neither finite sampling nor unproved infinite extrapolation is invoked.

originality.rationale: The 2013 Lemma 5 already establishes weak acyclicity given an equilibrium and is excluded as a novelty claim. The 2023 game-connectivity article establishes definitions and asymptotics but reports finite-size simulation rather than a complete exact three-cube joint table. Our inspected sources did not give the simultaneous five-row connectivity/superconnectivity/acyclicity census, the orbit distribution, or the two proved cube-specific exclusions. Unindexed equivalent graph-orientation tables remain a specific publication-priority risk.

value.rationale: Finite three-player binary games are the first cubic action-profile graph, directly testing new game-connectivity notions beyond asymptotic predictions. The complete exact distribution determines 2492/3134 connected and 384/3134 super-connected probabilities conditional on equilibrium and classifies 112 symmetry types; the structural incompatibility of acyclicity with super-connectedness and the forced connectivity of cyclic equilibrium games are meaningful boundaries unavailable from weak-acyclicity alone. These are motivated natural invariants of the standard game class rather than arbitrary slices.
